0.$description: Sharp corners, viewport-attached edges, adjoining surfaces, and precision-oriented elements where rounding is inappropriate.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Sharp corners, viewport-attached edges, adjoining surfaces, and precision-oriented elements where rounding is inappropriate.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Using sharp corners randomly among otherwise matching components.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Checkboxes and very small controls needing restrained rounding.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Default buttons, cards, and large containers.

8.$description: Default buttons, inputs, and regular interactive controls.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Default buttons, inputs, and regular interactive controls.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Replacing the full-rounding recipe for chips and pills.

12.$description: Grouped controls, compact cards, and smaller nested surfaces.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Grouped controls, compact cards, and smaller nested surfaces.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Automatically applying to every small component.

16.$description: Panels, popovers, and larger cards; pair floating surfaces with their appropriate surface and elevation roles.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Panels, popovers, and larger cards; pair floating surfaces with their appropriate surface and elevation roles.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Using radius alone to communicate elevation or separation.

24.$description: Dialogs and sheets where geometry permits rounded outer corners.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Dialogs and sheets where geometry permits rounded outer corners.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Rounding sheet edges that attach flush to the viewport.

default.$description: Optional table/section separator or necessary control outline.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Optional table/section separator or necessary control outline.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Boxing every cell, default card borders, and keyboard focus.

strong.$description: Selection and drop-target attention rings when the component defines a distinct state color and non-color state cue.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Selection and drop-target attention rings when the component defines a distinct state color and non-color state cue.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: General structural borders and keyboard focus; focus has its own geometry even when both widths are 2px.
Treating the normal control border as the focus indicator.

none.$description: No animated transition; the lower endpoint of the documented reduced-motion range (0–80ms). @a11y Remove nonessential motion instead of merely shortening it.

sourceAnnotations.usage: No animated transition; the lower endpoint of the documented reduced-motion range (0–80ms). @a11y Remove nonessential motion instead of merely shortening it.

dissolve.$description: Immediate state updates and navigation transitions when motion improves orientation. Keep persistent navigation UI stable.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Immediate state updates and navigation transitions when motion improves orientation. Keep persistent navigation UI stable.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Animating every route change or delaying an immediate update.

feedback.$description: Hover, pressed, color changes, toggles, and subtle elevation transitions. Separate from dissolve despite the equal value.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Hover, pressed, color changes, toggles, and subtle elevation transitions. Separate from dissolve despite the equal value.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Artificial interaction delays or mandatory press scaling.

overlay.$description: Entry timing for popovers, menus, and dialogs.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Entry timing for popovers, menus, and dialogs.
sourceAnnotations.rules: Exit timing generally uses 75–85% of entry duration.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Applying the same full duration indiscriminately to every exit.

reduced.$description: Upper bound for useful opacity feedback under reduced motion. Choose no transition or a duration within 0–80ms as appropriate. @a11y Remove nonessential movement and scaling entirely. This token does not authorize translating/scaling an element for 80ms.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Upper bound for useful opacity feedback under reduced motion. Choose no transition or a duration within 0–80ms as appropriate. @a11y Remove nonessential movement and scaling entirely. This token does not authorize translating/scaling an element for 80ms.

presentation.$description: Optional nonessential expressive motion, primarily in landing pages and presentation experiences.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Optional nonessential expressive motion, primarily in landing pages and presentation experiences.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Everyday product workflows and decorative product entrances. @a11y Remove this motion when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

standard.$description: Standard easing for state transitions and interaction feedback.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Standard easing for state transitions and interaction feedback.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Bounce, elastic, overshoot, or exaggerated spring replacements.

enter.$description: Elements entering a view or overlay becoming visible.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Elements entering a view or overlay becoming visible.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Adding an entrance animation solely because content appears.

exit.$description: Elements leaving a view or overlay being dismissed.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Elements leaving a view or overlay being dismissed.
sourceAnnotations.rules: Select exit timing separately from the easing curve.

linear.$description: Constant-rate animation when constant progression is intended.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Constant-rate animation when constant progression is intended.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Treating linear as the default for every interaction.

popover-subtle.$description: Optional 2px translation with opacity for popovers and menus.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Optional 2px translation with opacity for popovers and menus.
sourceAnnotations.rules: Lower endpoint of the documented 2–4px translation guidance; not a required minimum movement. @a11y Remove translation under reduced motion.

popover-max.$description: Maximum optional translation for popovers and menus.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Maximum optional translation for popovers and menus.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Movement greater than 4px or unnecessary combined effects. @a11y Remove translation under reduced motion.

dialog-max.$description: Maximum optional dialog translation, paired with opacity.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Maximum optional dialog translation, paired with opacity.
sourceAnnotations.rules: Use translation or subtle scale when helpful; avoid combining effects unnecessarily.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Treating 8px movement as mandatory for every dialog. @a11y Remove translation under reduced motion.

subtle.$description: Opt-in press feedback for selected controls, or a dialog's starting scale when subtle scaling improves the interaction.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Opt-in press feedback for selected controls, or a dialog's starting scale when subtle scaling improves the interaction.
sourceAnnotations.rules: 0.98 is the documented minimum scale; do not shrink further. Buttons normally use subtle color/elevation feedback. Dialogs may pair opacity with scale from 0.98 to 1 instead of translation.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Applying scale to all buttons, table rows, forms, or persistent UI. @a11y Remove scaling under reduced motion; use rest scale directly.

rest.$description: Unscaled rest state and endpoint of optional subtle scaling.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Unscaled rest state and endpoint of optional subtle scaling.
sourceAnnotations.rules: Identity transform, not an additional expressive scale preset.

fa.$description: Persian interface text, paragraphs and headings.

code.$description: Standalone code, commands and technical literals only.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Standalone code, commands and technical literals only.

reading.$description: Single maximum for long-form text; shrink to available width.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Single maximum for long-form text; shrink to available width.

groupAnnotations.usage: Floating toolbars, navigation flyouts, dropdowns, and popovers.

blur.$description: Opt-in glass for content-rich panels, expanded navigation and modals on controlled backdrops; opaque raised surfaces remain the default.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Opt-in glass for content-rich panels, expanded navigation and modals on controlled backdrops; opaque raised surfaces remain the default.

groupAnnotations.usage: Content-rich floating panels, expanded navigation, and glass modals.
groupAnnotations.avoid: Treating glass as a substitute for structural surface separation or modal focus management. @a11y Validate text and interactive states over representative backdrops.

groupAnnotations.avoid: Placing over the modal content, using as a glass panel fill, or silently aliasing to rds.color.scrim.modal. @a11y The modal must remain distinct and keyboard focus contained.
